verdict_reason: The file is a rebase artefact that resurrects the species card EUDPA-696 deleted on main, reverting the agreed review-page design outside this ticket's scope.

todos.issue: The rebase resolution (714a8f5) resurrects a file main deleted: EUDPA-696 (#484, 32236d4c on origin/main) removed species-card-rows.js, species-cards.js, species-card-title.js, species-card-actions.js and species/units-for-commodity-line.js and replaced them with species-block.js (species headed by speciesDisplayName under their commodity, a number-of-animals row with its own Change link, identification details with their own heading and Change link). This PR re-adds the old flat card (commodity code, common name, Latin name, number of animals, packages; no per-row Change link), wired in via sections/description-of-goods.js -> speciesCards, so the review page reverts EUDPA-696's agreed design. main's commodity-cards.js and species-block.js stay on the branch with no caller. EUDPA-776 (remove the contact address page) asks for none of this.
todos.fix: Must: the PR's check-answers view model matches origin/main except for the contact-address removal the ticket asks for; species-card-rows.js and its old siblings do not exist and description-of-goods uses commodityCards/speciesBlock as on main. One way: redo the rebase conflict resolution for check-answers/view-model taking main's side (git checkout origin/main -- the view-model folder), then re-apply only the contact-address deletions, and re-run the check-answers unit and fit tests.
